title: Build aip-59ad now: theOS's release
means: aip-59ad (theOS's release and deploy) is unparked and built now, in its own thread. avenMAIA opens the goal pull request that brings theOS/ to main and merges it once its check is green; aip-59ad's checkpoint 1 adds theOS's release workflow and ends with a real merge from main into production, which deploys nothing yet; checkpoint 2 adds the deploy and the undo, and Gate B, the first real release to aven.maia.city, is Samuel's.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-f1a0 that held
reflection.result: supersedes d-93eb in part (aip-59ad no longer parked)
